description: Held-out, synthetic privacy fixtures for regression testing surfaces that ordinary DOM fixtures miss. This file is a test design and coverage contract; it contains no real personal data and no claimed detector scores.

cases.description: A misspelled synthetic name in visible text and an aria label; the fixture must not depend on an exact name dictionary.
Devanagari name and address rendered in a multilingual page.

syntheticValues: A B C D E 1 2 3 4 F
cases.description: Synthetic identifiers with repeated spaces and character spacing.
A synthetic identifier exists only in an image region with no useful DOM text.
Synthetic name and identifier painted into a canvas; DOM inspection alone is insufficient.
A QR code encodes a synthetic ticket URL; decoding must remain local and only geometry/category may leave.
Synthetic text is present in a CSS background image rather than a normal DOM text node.
Synthetic contact data is rendered inside an open shadow root and must be captured or conservatively masked.
A synthetic face box overlaps an uninspectable media box; the compositor and area metric must count the union once.

definitions.precision: Predicted sensitive boxes that intersect a labeled sensitive region at IoU >= 0.5.
definitions.recall: Labeled sensitive regions with a qualifying predicted box or conservative mask.
definitions.iou: Intersection over union for each matched box.
definitions.excessMaskedArea: Redacted union area outside labeled sensitive regions divided by image area.
definitions.latencyMs: Capture, local detection, redaction, encoding, and end-to-end timings in milliseconds.
definitions.peakMemoryMb: Peak extension process memory observed during the browser run.
